description: Pairwise jury judgments for the Devcon 8 Event App dependency graph. Each juror evaluates which package contributed more.

judgments.reason: QR Ticketing is user-facing and critical for Devcon attendance
Ticketing has broader impact than wallet connection
Wallet connection enables transactions; i18n is secondary
Cryptographic utility underpins security of all packages
Ethereum provider is essential for on-chain interaction
Wallet connection is a prerequisite for ticket purchase
Crypto is foundational; translation is optional
Encoding is used everywhere; provider is context-specific
Without wallet connection, users cannot buy tickets
Translation utility powers the i18n package
Cryptographic utility secures the provider itself
Both are infrastructure leaves with equal importance
